question: Should ClawHub own runtime promotions as a core platform surface now, including permanent promotion records, public/admin APIs, hosted feed publication, homepage placement, admin CLI commands, and a production deploy publish step?
rationale: This is a new product and release workflow, not a bug fix; automation can review implementation shape but cannot decide long-term platform ownership or launch timing.

options.title: Accept After Deploy Proof
options.body: Verify the promotions snapshot publish command on a safe deployment path, then undraft and merge the feature as a ClawHub-owned platform surface.

options.title: Keep Draft Until Consumer Lands
options.body: Leave this PR open as the producer branch until the OpenClaw promos consumer is accepted enough to coordinate copy and release sequencing.

options.title: Do Not Add Core Promotions Yet
options.body: Close or narrow the PR if maintainers decide promotional offers should not become a ClawHub core platform surface at this time.

recommendation.title: Accept After Deploy Proof
recommendation.body: Verify the promotions snapshot publish command on a safe deployment path, then undraft and merge the feature as a ClawHub-owned platform surface.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the member author and current feature driver for this promotions branch and its linked consumer context.
